findings.observation: The name of the request header this route's body depends on is now written twice in one file: the const SEC_FETCH_DEST_HEADER = "sec-fetch-dest" at keyboard.rs:335, used for the lookup in help_variant, and the literal HeaderValue::from_static("Sec-Fetch-Dest, Cookie") inside with_cache_contract, in a different case. Before the repair the Vary value was built from the const. A future change to the header the arm reads must now be made in two places, and a grep for the const's value does not find the Vary declaration. The two spellings are harmless to a cache (field names are case-insensitive). Severity Low; HeaderValue::from_static needs a literal, so the duplication is partly a language constraint.
findings.remediation: Name the Vary value in one const beside SEC_FETCH_DEST_HEADER (for example HELP_VARY = "Sec-Fetch-Dest, Cookie") with a one-line note that it repeats the header name because from_static needs a literal, and have a debug assertion or a comment tie the two together.

Three templates share the ONE rows partial, so no arm can advertise a key another does not; the no-script full-page help keeps working by class on both page frames with no role and no aria-label.
